mapper.select: SELECT nb.id as id, nb.title as title, pf.nickname as authorName, nb.view_cnt as viewCnt, nb.created_at as createdAt, nb.updated_at as updatedAt FROM notice_board nb JOIN user u ON nb.author_id = u.id JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = u.id WHERE nb.is_removed = false ORDER BY nb.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT nb.id as notice_id, nb.title as title, pf.nickname as authorName, nb.content as content, nb.view_cnt as viewCnt, nb.created_at as createdAt, nb.updated_at as updatedAt,
nip.id as img_id, nip.saved_file_name as img_name, nip.path as img_path, nip.size as img_size
FROM notice_board nb JOIN user u ON nb.author_id = u.id JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN notice_board_image_property nip ON nb.id = nip.board_id
WHERE nb.id = #{id} AND nb.is_removed = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice_board (author_id, title, content, view_cnt, is_removed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{viewCnt}, #{isRemoved}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt});
mapper.update: UPDATE notice_board SET is_removed = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id};

UPDATE notice_board
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id};
